rules: PO: Header Fields are asked once per PO; Line Item Fields once per PO line. RFQ / Auction: Quote Sheet fields are columns of the bid sheet (one value per line); Global Sheet fields are asked once per quote.

Product, Quantity Requested, Delivery location (filled by the buyer) and Quantity Available, Price (filled by the vendor), Total Amount = Price × Quantity Available, Gross Total = SUM of Total Amount. They are marked "not removable", but the builder shows a bin on them anyway.

Every field has a key used by formulas, reports and integrations. For new fields it is made from the label + "_custom" ("Freight Charges" → freight_charges_custom) while the key is still empty. Standard fields' keys are fixed.
PO: keys must be unique across the whole template. RFQ: the page checks each sheet on its own; the server then refuses the same key across sheets with "Duplicate columns: X and Y".

Written with {Field Name}; stored with keys. Only numbers, quantities, formulas (and dropdowns) can be used. The page flags unknown fields and unbalanced brackets but does not stop Save; the server refuses empty formulas, unknown keys, text fields and a formula that uses itself ("Invalid Formula for X"). It does NOT refuse two formulas that use each other, division by zero, or a Global formula using a line field without SUM.

RANK LINES BY decides L1 per line, RANK LOTS BY per lot. Buy: lowest wins; Sell: highest wins. The old builder offered only price/amount fields; the new one offers every field. If the ranking field is missing, events rank lines by Price.
Name required; at least one field; every field needs a name and a key; names unique per type and order type (letter case not compared). PO templates have no further server checks.
Update replaces the template's settings with the ranking settings only, and its Terms & Conditions with an empty list (the builder sends nothing else) — test on copies.

After an award the PO form uses the company's standard PO template (or the one linked to the event's template). New templates from Manage Templates are saved as non-standard. If a company has any PO template, the PO step expects PO forms.
